Notes: Script data/rankings/fairvote_cvr.py (source file Minneapolis_20171107_BoardofTaxationAtLarge.tab). Design record data/rankings/design_tables.csv. Not on Redivis yet. Checked against the city's own 2017 cast vote record for this contest (identical ballots) and its certified one-round count: counting each ballot for its first ranking that names a single candidate reproduces it (an overvoted position is skipped, the ballot moving on to its next ranking, and a skipped position is passed over; a repeated candidate cannot matter in one round). The named write-ins are the write-in candidates the city reports by name, apart from its undeclared write-ins; Code 167.50(c) has each declared write-in candidate recorded by name and the undeclared write-ins as a group. So it does not test how fractional transfers are rounded.
